description: This file contains shell test scripts for corner cases in Git's identity string handling, including various scenarios for author and committer name detection and error messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, takes a description and a command block.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables in a way suitable for the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if specific patterns exist or do not exist in a file output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or variables.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Indicates the end of the test script.
